paite: TOUPA'N hichi in achi: "Moab tatlekna thumte ziak in, ahi lite ziak in, agawtna ka daisak kei ding; Edom kumpipa guhte sunu bang zen a ahal ziak in.
heading: Moab tung a thukhenna
english: Yahweh says: “For three transgressions of Moab, yes, for four, I will not turn away its punishment, because he burned the bones of the king of Edom into lime;

paite: Himahleh Moab tung ah mei ka sawl ding a, Kerioth kumpipa guhte akang khin ding; huan Moab buaina leh kikou leh pengkul ging in asi ding hi.
english: but I will send a fire on Moab, and it will devour the palaces of Kerioth; and Moab will die with tumult, with shouting, and with the sound of the trumpet;

paite: Huai lak a kipan vaihawmmi ka hihmang ding a, amiliante tengteng, amah toh ka that ding," TOUPA'N achi.
english: and I will cut off the judge from among them, and will kill all its princes with him,” says Yahweh.

paite: TOUPA'N hichi in achi: "Judah tatlekna thumte ziak in, ahi lite ziak in, agawtna ka daisak kei ding; TOUPA dan adeih kei ua, athupiakte azui kei uh, apate uh chih sek azuaugente un amaute apimang ziak in.
heading: Judah tung a thukhenna
english: Yahweh says: “For three transgressions of Judah, yes, for four, I will not turn away its punishment, because they have rejected Yahweh’s law, and have not kept his statutes, and their lies have led them astray, after which their fathers walked;

paite: Himahleh Judah tung ah mei ka sawl ding a, Jerusalem kumpipa' inn te akang khin ding," chi in.
english: but I will send a fire on Judah, and it will devour the palaces of Jerusalem.”

paite: TOUPA'N hichi in achi: "Israel tatlekna thumte ziak in, ahi lite ziak in, agawtna ka daisak kei ding; dangkasik a midiktat azuak uleh khedap but khat a mitasam azuak ziak un.
heading: Israel tung thukhenna
english: Yahweh says: “For three transgressions of Israel, yes, for four, I will not turn away its punishment, because they have sold the righteous for silver, and the needy for a pair of sandals;

paite: Gentheite leivui bang a sikden ut tuntun a, mizawngte vaihawmna akaikawi uhi; huan, mi khat leh apa nungak khat kiang ah ka min hihnin ding in ahoh zel uhi.
english: They trample the heads of the poor into the dust of the earth and deny justice to the oppressed. A man and his father use the same maiden, to profane my holy name.

paite: Maitam tengteng kiangchin a khamna puanphah tung ah alum zel ua, a Pathian uh inn a mi aliausakna mante un uain adawn zel uh," chi in.
english: They lay themselves down beside every altar on clothes taken in pledge. In the house of their God they drink the wine of those who have been fined.

paite: "Himahleh amau ma a Amorte, Sidar bang a sang leh tosaw bang a khauh hihmang a; tunglam a kipan agah leh nuailam a kipan azung leng hihmangpa ka hi.
english: Yet I destroyed the Amorite before them, whose height was like the height of the cedars, and he was strong as the oaks; yet I destroyed his fruit from above, and his roots from beneath.

paite: Huan Amorte gam nei ding in Aigupta gam a kipan in ka hon pikhia a, gamdai ah kum sawmli sung ka hon pi hi.
english: Also I brought you up out of the land of Egypt and led you forty years in the wilderness, to possess the land of the Amorite.

paite: Huan zawlnei hi ding in na tapate uh lak a mi leh Nazaritte hi ding in na tangvalte uh lak a mi ka bawl a, Aw Israel suante aw, huchibang in ahi kei a hia? TOUPA'N achi.
english: I raised up some of your sons for prophets, and some of your young men for Nazirites. Isn’t this true, you children of Israel?” says Yahweh.

paite: Himahleh Nazarit mite kiang ah uain dawn ding na pia ua, zawlneite kiang ah, thu gen kei un, chi in thu na pia uhi.
english: “But you gave the Nazirites wine to drink, and commanded the prophets, saying, ‘Don’t prophesy!’

paite: Ngai dih ua, kangtalai a buhphal sawnsip bang in, na mun uah ka hon sawn ding hi.
english: Behold, I will crush you in your place, as a cart crushes that is full of grain.

paite: Huan mitaihatte hatna amang ding a, mihat in tha asuah thei sam kei ding hi; mihat mahmah leng akihumbit thei kei ding hi.
english: Flight will perish from the swift. The strong won’t strengthen his force. The mighty won’t deliver himself.

paite: Thalpeu zangmi leng adingh thei sam kei ding; paihat thei mi leng akihumbit thei kei ding, sakol tungtuangmi leng akihumbit thei kei ding hi.
english: He who handles the bow won’t stand. He who is swift of foot won’t escape. He who rides the horse won’t deliver himself.

paite: Huai ni chiang in mi thilhihthei mahmah lak a mihangsan leng vuaktang in ataimang ding uh," TOUPA'N achi.
english: He who is courageous among the mighty will flee away naked on that day,” says Yahweh.
